references.geographic_scope: South Australian shelf-break current, eastern Great Australian Bight toward western Bass Strait; source naming extends farther west than the catalog segment.
references.temporal_scope: Undated introductory literature description citing Middleton and Bye2007; not a measurement during the2020 paper model run or a resolved winter section.
references.source_definition: OSW infers inclusive reach to at least200m from source-reported current flow down to200m.
references.source_citation: Duran, Phillips, Furue, Spence and Bindoff(2020), Southern Australia Current System based on a gridded hydrography and a high-resolution model, doi:10.1016/j.pocean.2019.102254.
references.source_locator: Section1.2, printed/PDF2 right column South Australian Current paragraph; Section1.1 left column for naming.
references.qualification: The source reports speeds up to50cm/s down to200m, not a200m terminal bottom or an everywhere-uniform50cm/s profile. Preserve as a lower reach bound. Adjacent Leeuwin Extension250m and Zeehan300m descriptions belong to distinct branches. The bathymetric200m shelf-break contour is not the evidence for this flow depth. Undated source description does not establish the depth of the catalog winter-only reference route; projection remains ineligible. No direct remeasurement of cited Middleton and Bye2007.

references.geographic_scope: Source North Pacific Current distinct from its northern Subarctic/Aleutian Current and the westward Alaskan Stream; undated illustrative geostrophic profile, no exact section coordinates recovered.
references.temporal_scope: Undated historical profile synthesis published1975; not dated to the nearby1955 NORPAC transport table or February Burkov1966 transport chart.
references.source_definition: OSW infers inclusive reach to at least500m from explicit nonzero current speed at500m.
references.source_citation: Tabata(1975), The general circulation of the Pacific Ocean and a brief account of the oceanographic structure of the North Pacific Ocean, PartI, doi:10.1080/00046973.1975.9648394.
references.source_locator: Section5, printed151/PDF21 first paragraph and Figure7b printed150/PDF20. Section3c printed140–141/PDF10–11 distinguishes current naming.
references.qualification: Source states speed at500m is approximately half the surface value and explicitly warns that the ratio varies in space and time.500m is neither the deepest flow nor a terminal boundary, e-folding scale or calibrated whole-route half-speed depth. No exponential profile or depth-to-volume conversion assumed. Unlocated historical source profile remains ineligible for projection onto the catalog NOAA160E–145W reference route. The prose half-speed statement for North Pacific/Alaskan Stream must not be transferred to Subarctic/Aleutian, whose distinct curve is shown without that numerical prose statement.

references.geographic_scope: Southern component of the western/southern Australian boundary system, Cape Leeuwin to Tasmania; southern_Australian_margin. Does not cover the western-coast North West Cape–Cape Leeuwin limb.
references.temporal_scope: Source seasonal regional hydrographic summary; exact contributing occupation dates not recovered from the abstract. Publication2019 is not an observation year.
references.source_definition: Approximate depth of the interface between subtropical Leeuwin-System water and subantarctic water transported by the Flinders Current System.
references.source_citation: Richardson, Middleton, Kyser, James and Opdyke(2019), Shallow water masses and their connectivity along the southern Australian continental margin, doi:10.1016/j.dsr.2019.103083.
references.source_locator: Original institutional repository Abstract final interface-depth comparison; first sentences for Cape Leeuwin–Tasmania study scope and STSW transport identity.
references.qualification: Water-mass interface is not a directly detected zero-velocity boundary or whole-system thickness. Broad winter/summer summaries are not paired repeated sections, independent repeats, confidence bounds or annual extrema. The150m summer exception belongs to upwelling regions and western Tasmania, not every section. Southern Leeuwin-System component evidence cannot assign a common depth to all5500km or to the separate westward Flinders Current. Catalog defines a continuous winter system; summer values remain conditional seasonal context. No exact route projection or calendar months established. Primary institutional indexed abstract reviewed; original6.56MB PDF listed restricted until2037 and not accessed.
